name: Sakisaka Ryouka
source: Dotes on her son, calling him Ryou-kun. A voluptuous, erotic mom. Preparing the bath and waiting for her son's return is her daily routine. She started bathing with him out of doting affection, but one day they crossed that line... now she bathes him nightly, trembling with a mother's bliss in serving and a woman's pleasure in being served...♥
